description: AEGIS host-hunt pack. Cross-platform collectors for the endpoint/host artifact checklist. Install: place in /etc/osquery/packs/ and reference from osquery.conf, or run `osqueryi --pack aegis-host.pack.json`. Snapshot queries feed the host scorers; _events queries need the matching eventing tables enabled (evented config).

persistence_launchd.query: SELECT path, name, program, program_arguments, run_at_load, keep_alive FROM launchd;
persistence_launchd.description: macOS Launch Agents/Daemons. ATT&CK T1543.001/.004. Diff vs baseline -> persistence_new.

persistence_crontab.query: SELECT event, minute, hour, command, path FROM crontab;
persistence_crontab.description: cron persistence. ATT&CK T1053.003. Watch web-service users (www-data) especially.

persistence_startup_items.query: SELECT name, path, source, status, username FROM startup_items;
persistence_startup_items.description: Cross-platform autostart (Run keys, login items, systemd user). ATT&CK T1547.

persistence_services_win.query: SELECT name, path, start_type, status, user_account FROM services WHERE start_type IN ('AUTO_START','SYSTEM_START');

persistence_scheduled_tasks_win.query: SELECT name, action, path, enabled, hidden FROM scheduled_tasks WHERE enabled=1;

persistence_systemd.query: SELECT id, description, fragment_path, user FROM systemd_units WHERE sub_state='running';
persistence_systemd.description: systemd units/timers. ATT&CK T1543.002/T1053.006. (needs systemd_units table build)

persistence_authorized_keys.query: SELECT uid, key_file, algorithm, key FROM authorized_keys;
persistence_authorized_keys.description: SSH authorized_keys. ATT&CK T1098.004. New key = lateral/persistence lead.

exec_lolbin_events.query: SELECT pid, path, cmdline, parent, uid, time FROM process_events WHERE path LIKE '%powershell%' OR path LIKE '%certutil%' OR path LIKE '%mshta%' OR path LIKE '%rundll32%' OR cmdline LIKE '%-enc%' OR cmdline LIKE '%FromBase64String%' OR cmdline LIKE '%curl %' OR cmdline LIKE '%wget %';
exec_lolbin_events.description: LOLBin / encoded-command execution. ATT&CK T1059/T1218. Needs process auditing (audit_allow_process).

net_egress_events.query: SELECT pid, path, remote_address, remote_port, time FROM socket_events WHERE action='connect' AND remote_port NOT IN (53,80,443,123);
net_egress_events.description: Outbound connects on odd ports. ATT&CK T1071/T1571. Feed c2_beacon scorer for periodicity.

net_etc_hosts.query: SELECT address, hostnames FROM etc_hosts WHERE address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1','::1','255.255.255.255');

webshell_webroot_scripts.query: SELECT f.path, f.size, f.mtime, h.sha256 FROM file f JOIN hash h ON f.path=h.path WHERE (f.path LIKE '/var/www/%' OR f.path LIKE '%/inetpub/wwwroot/%') AND (f.filename LIKE '%.php' OR f.filename LIKE '%.jsp' OR f.filename LIKE '%.aspx') AND f.mtime > 0;
webshell_webroot_scripts.description: Script files in web roots -> webshell_drop scorer. ATT&CK T1505.003. Bridges to the perimeter SOC.

defense_ld_preload.query: SELECT key, value FROM augeas WHERE path='/etc/ld.so.preload' UNION SELECT 'LD_PRELOAD' AS key, variable_value AS value FROM process_envs WHERE variable_name='LD_PRELOAD';

defense_kernel_modules.query: SELECT name, size, used_by, status FROM kernel_modules;

macos_tcc_grants.query: SELECT service, client, allowed, prompt_count FROM access_policies WHERE service IN ('kTCCServiceCamera','kTCCServiceMicrophone','kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAllFiles','kTCCServiceAccessibility') AND allowed=1;
macos_tcc_grants.description: Sensitive TCC grants (spyware tell). ATT&CK T1123/T1113. Non-allowlisted client=1 -> tcc_grant scorer.

browser_extensions.query: SELECT name, identifier, version, path FROM chrome_extensions;
